newsitem.title: USA: Global Ocean Carriers revises Q4 net upward.
newsitem.headline: Global Ocean Carriers revises Q4 net upward.

text.p: Global Ocean Carriers Limited said Wednesday its audited net income for the year ended December 31 1997 was revised upwards to $1,020,631 ($0.25 per share) from the previously announced unaudited result of $705,533 ($0.17 per share).
Company President Nikolas Tsakos said the increase was due to an unrealized gain on marketable securities which was taken into account in the course of the annual audit.
Global Ocean Carriers is a Greece-based international shipping company specializing in the operation of feeder container vessels and dry bulk carriers.
